question: Where is the world's largest stupa located?
solution:
The correct answer is **Java.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Stupa is an important form of **Buddhist architecture.**

 
 
• It is a dirt burial mound faced with stone, often containing religious objects and used as a place of meditation.​
 
 
 
• **​Borobudur**
 
 
• ​​Borobudur is the world's largest stupa located in Java, Indonesia.
 
• It was built it in the 8th and 9th centuries AD during the reign of the **Shailendra Dynasty. **
 
• It is a **UNESCO World Heritage Site.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/179449cd45d51cb84b6c419eca198727295175b72e5bb8471ee210bfe135c304.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 India 
 India has the world's 2nd largest Buddhist stupa named Kesaria stupa in Bihar. It has been noted that the Kesaria stupa shares many architectural similarities with the Borobudur temple. 
 
 

 Sri Lanka 
 Stupas, also called Dagebas in Sri Lanka, are the largest brick structures known to the pre-modern world.
